question: How many times did India organise the Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Once.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Delhi in India organized the Commonwealth Games in 2010, only once.
 
• Australia hosted the Commonwealth Games the most (5) times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The first commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada.**

 
 
• In the Games, 11 countries sent 400 athletes to take part in six sports and 59 events.
 
• Since then, the Games have been conducted every four years (except for 1942 and 1946 due to World War II) and the event has seen many changes, not least in its name.
 
• The Commonwealth Games are overseen by the Commonwealth Games Federation (GCF), which also controls the sporting program and selects the host cities.
 
 
 
• The Commonwealth Games of Nations is an association of independent sovereign states, most of which are former colonies of the United Kingdom.
 
 
• The British Monarch remains the head of theCommonwealth Games
 
 
 
• **The 2022 Commonwealth** Games officially known as the XXII Commonwealth Games and commonly known as Birmingham 2022, took place in Birmingham, England.
